start: Staff & sign-in, signed in with a PIN as an owner; the "You" card shows the "Owner" pill

steps.action: Read the "You" card
user_sees: "You sign in with your mobile number and your own PIN (set on <day>)."
Button "Change my PIN"
must_not: The PIN itself shown anywhere
The button missing while the server has PINs switched on

steps.action: Tap "Change my PIN"
user_sees: Sheet "Change my PIN" with "Your current PIN", "Your new PIN (6 digits)" and "Type the PIN again"

"Forgot it? Make yourself a sign-in code in the list below, sign out, and sign in with that code. Then, for 15 minutes, you can set a new PIN without the old one. Stuck? Email MettleUp at contact@mettleup.fit." under the current PIN box
must_not: Digits shown in clear: all three boxes hide what is typed

steps.action: Type the current PIN, a new 6-digit PIN twice, tap "Save my PIN"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
Sheet closes; toast "PIN saved. Sign in with your mobile number and this PIN."
must_not: The old PIN still working at the next sign-in
This device signed out by the change
Two saves from a double tap

start: Sign-in page; an owner with no PIN yet signs in with a one-time code from the owner

steps.action: Type the mobile number and the code, tap "Sign in"
user_sees: The panel opens with the sheet "Set your own PIN"
"Save your own PIN. Next time, sign in with your mobile number and this PIN. You won’t need a code from the owner."
Buttons "Not now" and "Save my PIN"; no current PIN box
must_not: The sheet shown to someone who signed in with a PIN
The sheet shown again after "Not now"

steps.action: Type a new PIN twice, tap "Save my PIN"
user_sees: Toast "PIN saved. Next time, sign in with your mobile number and this PIN."
must_not: The prompt coming back on the next open of the panel on this device

start: Sign-in page; an owner who HAS a PIN but forgot it signs in with a one-time code

steps.action: Type the mobile number and the code, tap "Sign in"
user_sees: Sheet "Choose a new PIN?"
"You signed in with a one-time code. If you forgot your PIN, choose a new one now."
Buttons "Keep my old PIN" and "Save my PIN"; no current PIN box
must_not: The old PIN asked for inside the 15 minutes after a code sign-in

steps.action: Type a new PIN twice, tap "Save my PIN" within 15 minutes
user_sees: Toast "New PIN saved. Next time, sign in with your mobile number and this PIN."
must_not: The old PIN still accepted at the next sign-in

steps.action: Instead: leave the sheet open for more than 15 minutes (or come back to the open panel the next day), then tap "Save my PIN"
user_sees: A clear way to finish: a current PIN box, or words that say to sign in with a new code
must_not: "Type your current PIN first." with no box to type it in
A sheet that can only be left by "Keep my old PIN"

start: "Change my PIN" sheet open, signed in as an owner

steps.action: Leave the current PIN empty, tap "Save my PIN"
user_sees: "Type your current PIN first."
must_not: A save sent without the current PIN

steps.action: Type a wrong current PIN and a good new one, tap "Save my PIN"
user_sees: "That is not your current PIN. (<n> tries left)"; at the last one "That is not your current PIN. Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes."
must_not: The PIN changed with a wrong current PIN
Endless guesses with no lock

steps.action: Type the new PIN as 111111, then 123456, then the last 6 digits of the own mobile number, then two different PINs
user_sees: "Don’t use the same digit six times. Pick a PIN that is hard to guess."
"Don’t use digits in order, like 123456 or 654321. Pick a PIN that is hard to guess."
"Don’t use the end of your mobile number. Pick a PIN that is hard to guess."
"The two PINs are not the same. Type the same PIN in both boxes."
must_not: A weak PIN saved
Letters accepted: the boxes keep digits only, 6 at most

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; states of the "You" card

steps.action: Open the page with no PIN set
user_sees: "You have no PIN yet. Set one, and you can sign in any time with your mobile number and your PIN."
Button "Set my PIN"
must_not: "Change my PIN" offered when there is none

steps.action: Set a PIN, then look again
user_sees: "You sign in with your mobile number and your own PIN (set on <today>)."
Button "Change my PIN"
must_not: The card still saying there is no PIN after the save

steps.action: On your own row tap "Sign out other devices", then "Sign out"
user_sees: Sheet words end "Your PIN is cleared too. Set a new one in “You” above."; then the card says "You have no PIN yet…"
must_not: The cleared PIN still working at sign-in

steps.action: After too many wrong tries, open the page
user_sees: "Your PIN is locked till <time> after too many wrong tries. You can still sign in with a code from the owner."
must_not: A locked PIN shown as fine

steps.action: Set a PIN, then look at the page, at the people list on an owner's device and at the sign-in page
user_sees: Only "PIN set" style words and the day it was set; never the digits
must_not: The PIN shown, sent back by the server or kept on the device
An owner able to read or set another person's PIN
One person setting a PIN for another person's number
